_note: The 22 Major Arcana read as describing a person (Roger, 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-10: the card as significator, not its situational meaning), for gap-filling inspiration, not import.  Sources: A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1911, public domain), Part II section 2 (the figures; waite_part2_trumps_major.json) and Part III section 3 (the divinatory meanings; waite_part3_s3_greater_arcana_meanings.txt), from the sacred-texts edition (mirror, fetched 2026-10-10).  Each description is the agent's summary in the corpus form; waite gives the phrases it rests on.

cards.waite: a young man ... pauses at the brink of a precipice ... the edge which opens on the depth has no terror ... the spirit in search of experience; folly, mania, extravagance
cards.description: This means stepping into the unknown with a light heart: setting out on a whim, trusting the road to hold, and walking to the cliff's edge without a thought of falling.

cards.waite: smile of confidence and shining eyes ... the elements ... lie like counters before the adept, and he adapts them as he wills; skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety ... self-confidence, will
cards.description: This means bending the world to one's will with skill and nerve: a sure hand with every tool, a ready tongue, and the knack of making happen whatever one sets out to do.

cards.waite: partly covered by her mantle, to shew that some things are implied and some spoken ... the prevailing genius of the esoteric, withdrawn power; secrets, mystery ... silence
cards.description: This means keeping one's own counsel: knowing more than one says, holding secrets and hidden knowledge close, and answering a question with silence or a riddle.

cards.waite: the fruitful mother of thousands ... desire and the wings thereof ... universal fecundity; fruitfulness, action, initiative
cards.description: This means flourishing and making things flourish: abundant, sensual and generous, at home among growing things, children and plenty, and bringing comfort and new life wherever one settles.

cards.waite: a crowned monarch--commanding, stately ... executive and realization, the power of this world; stability, power, protection ... authority and will
cards.description: This means ruling: taking command, laying down order and structure, protecting those under one's authority, and expecting one's word to be law.

cards.waite: the ruling power of external religion ... exoteric orthodox doctrine ... the summa totius theologiae, when it has passed into the utmost rigidity of expression ... the head of the recognized hierarchy
cards.description: This means upholding the established faith and its institutions: teaching the received doctrine, keeping the rites and the hierarchy, and guiding others along the approved path.

cards.waite: youth, virginity, innocence and love ... the card of human love; attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome
cards.description: This means living for love: drawn to beauty and to one other person, choosing by the heart, and binding one's life and one's values to the one one loves.

cards.waite: the victorious hero ... conquest on all planes ... above all things triumph in the mind; war, triumph, presumption, vengeance
cards.description: This means driving on to victory: mastering opposing forces by sheer will, pressing through every trial, and taking pride in each conquest.

cards.waite: her beneficent fortitude has already subdued the lion, which is being led by a chain of flowers ... the higher nature in its liberation; power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity
cards.description: This means gentle courage: taming fury, one's own or another's, with patience and calm rather than force, and staying steady and magnanimous under pressure.

cards.waite: holding up his beacon on an eminence ... 'where I am, you also may be' ... a card of attainment; prudence, circumspection
cards.description: This means withdrawing from the crowd to seek wisdom alone, then holding up a lamp for whoever follows: solitary, prudent, inward-looking, and guiding by example.

cards.waite: the perpetual motion of a fluidic universe and ... the flux of human life ... the denial of chance and the fatality which is implied therein; destiny, fortune, success, elevation
cards.description: This means living by fate and fortune: seeing every rise and fall as the turn of a wheel, riding one's luck, and accepting whatever comes as destined.

cards.waite: the moral principle which deals unto every man according to his works; equity, rightness, probity
cards.description: This means weighing everything fairly and dealing with each person according to their deeds: impartial, truthful, upright, and unmoved by favor.

cards.waite: the face expresses deep entrancement, not suffering ... life in suspension; wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition
cards.description: This means letting go and seeing the world upside down: surrendering willingly, waiting in suspension without struggle, and finding insight through sacrifice.

cards.waite: change, transformation and passage from lower to higher ... rebirth, creation, destination, renewal; end, mortality, destruction
cards.description: This means ending things cleanly and moving on: letting the old die, cutting loose from whatever is finished, and welcoming transformation however hard it is.

cards.waite: pouring the essences of life from chalice to chalice ... it tempers, combines and harmonises the psychic and material natures; economy, moderation, frugality, management
cards.description: This means moderation in all things: blending and balancing opposites, keeping to the middle way, indulging little, and managing one's life with patience.

cards.waite: the chain and fatality of the material life ... the animal nature ... a bondsman, sustained by the evil that is in him; ravage, violence, vehemence
cards.description: This means being in thrall to appetite and to things: chained by lust, greed and habit, and tempting others into the same bondage.

cards.waite: the ruin of the House of Life, when evil has prevailed therein ... the rending of a House of Doctrine ... a House of Falsehood; misery, distress ... unforeseen catastrophe
cards.description: This means bringing things crashing down: tearing apart false structures and comfortable lies in one sudden blow, and living through upheaval and ruin.

cards.waite: eternal youth and beauty ... pours Water of Life from two great ewers ... a card of hope ... Truth unveiled; hope and bright prospects
cards.description: This means hope after the storm: serene, generous and open-hearted, pouring out what one has to renew others, and trusting in a brighter future.

cards.waite: life of the imagination apart from life of the spirit ... the fears of the natural mind ... only reflected light to guide it; hidden enemies ... deception, error
cards.description: This means living in the half-light of imagination: dreamy, uneasy and easily deceived, haunted by vague fears, and seeing shapes in the dark that may not be there.

cards.waite: a little child ... simplicity and innocence in the sense of wisdom ... the restored world; material happiness ... contentment
cards.description: This means radiant, childlike joy: open, simple and warm, full of vitality and contentment, and making everyone nearby feel happy and at ease.

cards.waite: the accomplishment of the great work of transformation in answer to the summons of the Supernal--which summons is heard and answered from within; change of position, renewal, outcome
cards.description: This means answering an inner call to rise and begin again: taking stock of one's life, judging it honestly, and being reborn to a new purpose.

cards.waite: the perfection and end of the Cosmos ... the rapture of the universe when it understands itself; assured success, recompense, voyage
cards.description: This means wholeness and fulfillment: at home in oneself and anywhere, having completed the journey, and moving through life with everything in its place.
